notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B analytics) evaluating Redwood Hosted API as first step; likely to move to Dedicated if latency/consistency improves. Key workload is a customer-facing chat assistant that calls internal tools (ticket lookup, entitlement checks) via tool-calling hooks. Primary success criteria are user-perceived latency and regression-gated quality for agent responses.

Important details / call notes (shorthand):
- "On demo: streaming + tool_calling impressed product team; liked structured function outputs" — PM quote.
- POC scope: 2 weeks, ~100k messages total, representative peak concurrency ~120 concurrent sessions.
- Latency targets: target p50 < 100ms streaming tokens after first token, p95 end-to-end < 400ms for 1-turn replies; product lead: "sub-200ms for first turn would be ideal."
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; wants a predictable cost model. Current vendor charges ~0.8x of budget; BeaconNova needs < $X per 1M tokens (billing discussed in pricing deck).
- Model preferences: open weights acceptable if quality matches; prefer smaller quantized variants for Dedicated to reduce latency and cost. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quant profiles.
- Evals gating: Engineering wants automatic prompt/eval regression checks on canary + A/B rollouts. Requirement: must be able to attach evals to rollout so any quality regression triggers rollback + alert to SE/CSM.
- Streaming behavior: must support low-latency first-token streaming and partial deltas to UI; they will instrument client to show typing indicator.
- Tool calling: deterministic structured outputs required (JSON schema). Concern: fallback behavior if model returns invalid JSON; want automatic retry to fallback model variant or function error flagging.
- Security: SSO (SAML) mandatory for access; need SOC2 report and audit_log retention 12 months. Data residency preference: US-only for PII flows; willing to accept VPC peering for dedicated.
- Integration notes: front-end uses websockets; backend orchestration built in-house (K8s). They want SDK/streaming examples for websocket + partial chunks.

Risks / open questions (CRM style):
- Hosted API POC shows p95 spikes on complex tool-call flows (heavy context + long tool invocations). Need root cause: batching behavior vs runtime kernels.
- Dedicated ROI: how much latency improvement to expect vs Hosted — request quantized model benchmark on same hardware profile.
- Eval automation: need examples of Redwood rollouts with eval gating (A/B + canary) and how alerts/rollbacks are surfaced.
- Procurement: legal review in progress, procurement needs line item for Dedicated monthly commit.

Action items / next steps:
- SE (Luca) to deliver POC latency baseline report by 2026-03-16 with breakdown: token-level latency, streaming-first-token, tool-call end-to-end, KV cache hit-rate. (linked Jira: INF-3271)
